input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 delivers the preferred position on its material terms: transition obligations are triggered "[u]pon expiry or termination for any reason" (11.1); Vendor must provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months (11.1), well above the 90-day fallback; Customer Data must be returned within thirty days in a "complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format" with metadata, and cannot be withheld over a fee dispute (11.2); and an authorized officer must certify secure deletion in writing after Customer confirms successful return (11.3). Two points are noted rather than flagged: assistance is priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form rather than Vendor's then-current rates (a Customer-favourable variation), and the 30-day return clock runs from Customer's request rather than from termination itself, which Customer controls and which is not limited to any pre-expiry window. Nothing in § 10 or § 15 permits earlier deletion or conditions assistance on the absence of a dispute, so no redline is warranted.
